guide: docs/test-writing-guide.md: Pre-Submit Checklist and Red Flags
method: All Task3 changed source diffs/new source, deadline/store/trail/API/public tests, collector helpers/five cases/coverage/operator instructions and full named reports reviewed as one coverage set. Existing Task1/2 owners preserved and independently hash-bound; no claim of a fresh manual review of every unchanged test.

findings.issue: Store COMMIT-response phase test alone did not execute public recovery advice.
findings.resolution: External store_test public Decide/GetPermission composition reuses internal Store test-only real SQLite driver boundary; no production seam. Real COMMIT succeeds then response expires, actual classifier returns ErrInternal and exact inspection phrase, fresh independent public reader sees allow, two reads preserve facts, exactly one verdict UPDATE/COMMIT. Distinct API recovery boundary complements SQL phase owner.

mandatory_unresolved.assertion: err store: commit outcome unconfirmed; read the request before retrying: context deadline exceeded matches []; want exactly ErrStoreBusy
mandatory_unresolved.facts: Unchanged original real-SQL legacy leaf, still parallel, MaxWaitMs 100ms and original no-sleep/1.1s physical assertion. Full subtest reported 1.53s including setup. Sentinel assertion is fatal, so later elapsed/no-write assertions did not execute. No phase trace proves an operation overrun or commit outcome.
mandatory_unresolved.assessment: New actual SQL/legacy error-contract failure, distinct from corrected three policy leaves; fresh Engineer source/test-contract assessment required. Existing source intentionally distinguishes unconfirmed COMMIT from precommit ErrStoreBusy. Real legacy path attempts guarded UPDATE and COMMIT before refusal-by-settle-time. Receipt alone does not prove whether anything committed or establish a source defect.
mandatory_unresolved.route: Do not relax sentinel/physical assertions, enlarge 100ms, lower parallelism, distort source or rerun unchanged. Preserve receipt and original protected 500ms/1.5s guards. Calling agent routes fresh assessment before necessary correction/new full run.

ownership.authenticated: O1-O6 and actual human/authenticated runtime predicates remain pending; synthetic received bytes/frames/source-derived questions never relabeled authenticated.

checklist.parameterization: Five SQL phases, three setup errors, four callers, three controls and four representative faults parameterized. All new Go files below 500 lines; existing larger files already feature grouped/parameterized.
checklist.fixtures: Existing relayEnv/parked decorator, apitest.SeedDecideFixtureAgent/procfix, deadlineBoundary/execHookConnector, cursorfix/newCursorPaneScenario/public adapter/owned-launch/sql reused. No copied controller/retry/queue implementation, helper-only tests, parallel exhaustive fault matrix, or newly unused helper found.
checklist.isolation: Per-test real SQLite; test singleton holders serial with reasons; public fixtures serial for HOME/PATH/tmux environment; independent tests parallel. Bun execution remains sequential. Finite contexts/event channels/process waits and owned cleanup retained.
checklist.preservation: Entry manifest binds all unchanged guards: Task1 R1-R5/E2 bounded pending/hash/dialog/answer gates, frame/request minima, postwait authority, independent permission/plan/unknown holds, question denial, ack before bytes and native pause/exact owned death. No deadline/SQL timeout/assertion relaxation, parallelism reduction, retry-until-green, or concurrent send atomicity promise.
checklist.evidence: Received raw bytes versus complete frames and source-derived versus received traffic are distinct; P1 startup/P2 completed publication/P3 partial-byte corrections reviewed. No audit fsync/crash durability claim; cleanup quarantines leases and original deadline/one-second zero-work semantics agree with docs. Native uninterruptible/descheduling limits remain explicit.
checklist.formal: No actual spec/tla input change; zero formal/parser/TLC/Java jobs.

doc_consistency: Five edited product docs remain unchanged from entry. Canonical changed recovery is caller-contract Permission relay. Architecture final 9593447 retained; inherited whole-base four partitions plus five verified deltas is aggregate coverage, not a fresh whole-file read or clean-document claim; deferred A2-A6/B3-B8/C2-C5/D1-D2 and inherited guide normalization remain deferred.
historical09: Both historical failure causes remain UNKNOWN. Controlled regression does not reconstruct them.

Exact 100ms/300ms policy calls use explicit cancelable context and stateful snapshots with existing decideWithin core. DecideWithSleep=decide and all physical deadline callers remain.

current_pass.cancellation: Both agents cancel immediately after the fixture commit; committed allow/not_confirmed/liveness/confirm_by survive with zero sleep and zero subsequent reads before independent inspection.

current_pass.fixture_limits: Policy fixture proves no real SQL locking, durability or physical deadlines. Real held-lock/precommit no-write guards, original-context public fresh recovery/GetPermission, F10 actual SQLite uncertain COMMIT, SQL cleanup and trail owners retained.
current_pass.docs: Source and five product docs unchanged. Test-only seam correction changes no product contract and requires no doc resync.
current_pass.retained_previous_failure: Prior full five failures preserved. Two Store cleanup observation repairs from previous pass retained; three API leaves corrected here.
current_pass.new_targeted_failure: 01-targeted: newly added observer assertion incorrectly used external pre-call timestamp as the API-created original deadline; context is created slightly later. Fixed assertion captures exact received context instead. Original elapsed guards never altered.
